description: What the project is and what its words mean, for agents writing for people who don't read the code. Drawn by the Briefer from the repos' own docs; edit it by hand freely.

about.description: What the project is and who it is for, in plain words a newcomer follows.

names.description: The things people name: the product, its pieces, its services. Write `name` as given; `aka` are other names the code and PRs use for the same thing.

terms.description: Words a newcomer won't know, and the plain words to use instead or to explain them once.

flows.description: How the project works, step by step, as its docs describe it: what happens to a request, a release, a record. The Explainer tours them; every agent may use them.

name.description: What flows, in plain words: "A sensor reading's way to the dashboard".

parts.description: The system map's part ids it crosses, in order.

steps.description: One plain sentence a step: who does what, and what happens when it fails, where the docs say.

from.description: The doc it is drawn from, as given in `docs`.
